sources.snippet: Model exceeds 7 of 7 benchmarks for Qwen 3.5 9B, Qwen3.5 27B, Qwen3.6 35B-A3B, and meets Qwen 3.6 27B in some cases... and it does so in 4bit and 8bit. Regular and MTP (fast) NEO IMATRIX GGUFs provided [links below].

sources.snippet: Overview Qwen3.5-9B-The-Defiant-Fable-Uncensored-Heretic-NEO-IMATRIX-MAX-MTP-GGUF is a fine-tuned 9-billion-parameter language model built by DavidAU that achieves benchmark scores exceeding multiple larger Qwen models while remaining fully uncensored and optimized for consumer hardware. The model is a multi-stage, multi-model fine-tune and merge incorporating several of DavidAU's previous 9B ...

sources.title: Qwen3.5-9B-The-Defiant-Fable-Uncensored-Heretic-NEO-IMATRIX-MAX-MTP-GGUF
sources.snippet: GGUF-quantized releases (NEO IMATRIX + MTP) of a multi-stage fine-tuned, uncensored Qwen3.5-9B model with vision enabled and a native 256k context window—optimized for instruction following, reasoning and image-text-to-text workflows; released under Apache-2.0.
